title: Championship added to Highlights
desc: The Championship has now been added to highlights, again if you spot any missing, please feedback through the feedback form in settings and I'll pick it up.

title: Match Highlights
desc: Finished matches now show a YouTube icon and a 'Watch highlights' link when one's available — currently covers Premier League, Carabao Cup, Champions League, Europa League and Conference League. FA Cup isn't included since coverage is split between broadcasters. Still bedding in, especially for the European competitions, so a few matches might not pick up their clip right away — let me know via the feedback form if one's clearly missing.

title: Managers
desc: Managers have now been added with a win percentage, I am aware of some issues over the info for some managers being presented, looking to fix this over the next few days. If there are any outside of the Premier League you notice, please fill in the feedback form to let me know.

title: Transfers Added
desc: As much detail over transfers and fees have been added as much as possible across all leagues covered. Hopefully your team is included

title: Squads Added
desc: You can now view your own or other teams squads including their goals & appearances data and more.
